NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author says they reworked the PR description to discuss the completion candidate (#33086) and added a whitespace fix with a test. The description does now cover #33086, but the screenshots are still laid out the same way.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The description now explains how this PR relates to completion candidate #33086, with the differences and the reason for a fresh implementation. |
| ❌  | Screenshots are still not easy to compare: unlabeled images in separate "Before" and "After" lists, with different counts (4 vs 2) and no table pairing the same input before and after. |
| ⚠️  | The whitespace fix (`](` followed by a space) and its test are claimed in the comment, but the bot couldn't find the head commit, so it's unconfirmed that anything was pushed. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for precise, paired before/after screenshots; a maintainer can separately decide whether a fresh rewrite is acceptable given the completion candidate.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the discussion of #33086, @PrinceXDev, that part looks good. The screenshots still need to be reworked following the [guidelines on precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots): please show the same input before and after side by side, e.g. in a table with labeled rows, so the change can be compared directly.
```
